_about: Every sound effect the game could use. `npm run sfx` checks public/sounds against this list, writes public/sounds/manifest.json (what the game may load: no manifest entry, no request, no 404) and docs/SFX-TRACKER.md. A sound can have up to 3 variants: name.mp3, or name_1.mp3, name_2.mp3, name_3.mp3 (.ogg/.wav/.webm also work). `wired` says whether the game plays it yet. Entries with "ambience": true are place sounds: one slot per place, `<place>-background` with up to three variants (the-goose-and-kettle-background_1.mp3 to _3), in public/ambience (not public/sounds). A place is a location, or a family of places (tavern, fortress...) whose sounds stand in for any location of that family that has none of its own. `npm run sfx` writes public/ambience/manifest.json for them.
